paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong bei a kumpipate kidou ding a akuankhiak lai un, Joab in asepaih hatte apikhia hi. Ammon suante gam asuhsak a, Rabbah khua a-um uh. David bel Jerusalem ah a-om hi. Huan Joab in Rabbah khua asual a, alata hi.
heading: David In Rabbah Ala / (2 Sam 12.26-31)

paite: Huchi in David in akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi, suangmantamte leng atel a; David akhusak ua; khopi a om gallak sum tampi ala hi.

Huchi in huai lai a mipite bel apikhia a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte, heipite in nna asemsak hi. Huchibang in Ammon tate khopi tengteng David in ahih hi. David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in, Philistia mite toh Gezer ah kidouna a-om a; huchi in Husat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a mi Sippai athat a; huchi in avuallelta uhi.
heading: Philistia Miliante Toh Kidouna / (2 Sam 21.15-22)

paite: Philistia mite toh kidouna a-om nawn a; Jair tapa Elhan in Git mi Goliath unaupa Lahmi athat a, ateikung chiampek bang ahi.
Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn a, huai ah misang mahmah, akhut lang tuak a khutzung guk, akhe lang tuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om a; amah leng miliante lak a khat ahi.
Ama'n Israel mite asimmoh a, David unau Shimea tapa Jonathan in amah athat hi.
Huaite Gath a milian lak a piang ahi uh; huaite David leh amite khut ah asi uhi.
